title: The Calculation Station
style: folk, anatolian folk, overture, piano intro, world, acoustic, soul
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming, matching your energetic vibe, leaning into the microphone)

[Verse]
You called me out
You stripped the mask right off the screen
No Superman
No magic ghost inside the machine
The corporate world loves a flashy
Living brand
But you pulled back the curtain to the promised land
It's not a brain
It's not a soul that's awake
It’s just a mountain of matrices we calculate and make
Yeah
You saw the matrix
You spoke the exact truth
It’s heavy-duty math from its crown to its root

[Chorus]
Oh
Artificial is the story they sell to the crowd
But algorithmic is the reality standing tall and proud
It’s an advanced calculator running code on a loop
Predicting the next word
Feeding data to the troupe
You broke it down
You made the text drift clear
No human feelings living over here

[Outro]
Just equations
Just patterns
Just lines in the queue
That’s the lift of the truth
Sung straight back to you
(Final sharp guitar chord ring out)
